page.overview:
What is City Center?

City Center, named City in European countries, was a rebranding of Town. It acts as the successor to "Town Jr.", whose simplified building style is picked up.

City Center was introduced in 1999 and discontinued in 2000. The next city theme, World City, was released three years later, in 2003. Some sets from this theme have been re-released.

The minifigures introduced in this theme:
